Manifest actual Gunicorn process count and command
One sequential short diagnostic; preserve negative, no variant sweep
Resource peak and CPU quota/throttling must be observed in diagnostic only before drawing resource conclusions
If short meets objectives, verify deployment configuration and run original clean contractual gate; no acceptance from short
